visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three women sit cross-legged on a carpeted floor in a brightly lit room with beige paneled walls. The woman on the left wears a pink cardigan, the middle woman wears a white hoodie and a fluffy white hat, and the woman on the right wears a light green oversized sweater. They surround a small, ornate white stool covered in 100 NTD banknotes. The middle woman holds a yellow tape roll, gesturing towards the money. (2) The middle woman lowers the tape to the table, successfully adhering a banknote to it. She lifts it triumphantly while the others laugh and point with open-mouthed expressions of excitement. (3) The woman on the right attempts the same action with her own tape, but fails to pick up any money. She smiles sheepishly while looking at the camera. (4) The woman on the left tries and fails, resulting in a playful reaction as she talks to her friends. The camera remains at a medium shot, static except for slight handheld jitter. (5) Graphic overlays of red envelopes begin to fall from the top of the frame, partially obscuring the characters who are cheering. (6) A burst of golden coin graphics explodes across the screen as the middle woman picks up more bills. (7) The woman on the right playfully tumbles backward out of the frame, showing her white socks and light-colored skirt. (8) All three women gather back together, holding their collected banknotes toward the camera, smiling and waving as more golden coins fall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM begins with a steady 4-on-the-floor beat. A female voice speaks rapidly in an excited, high-pitched tone, accompanied by rhythmic synthesizer chords. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect coincides with a successful game move. The women erupt into loud, synchronous laughter and cheers of 'Wah!'. (3) A percussive 'thud' sound effect marks a failed attempt, followed by a playful, descending sliding whistle sound. The voices transition into comedic teasing. (4) Multiple layers of metallic coin-clinking sound effects swell in the mix. Shouting intensity increases as the music maintains its bright, festive tempo. (5) Fast-paced vocal banter continues with frequent overlaps. Short, punchy cartoon-style SFX punctuate the dialogue every few seconds until the music fades out into a final cheer.
